crop_code.description: USDA CDL class code; 999 means aggregated Other only in the grouped table.

crop_name.description: Source crop/land-cover label; CDL_Class_* placeholders are preserved.

pixel_count.description: Valid classified 30 × 30 m pixels in this class; one pixel = 0.09 ha.

area_ha.description: Area of this crop class or transition.

area_pct.description: 100 × area_ha / the row's applicable denominator; source rounded to four decimals.

valid_denominator_ha.description: Year-specific valid county area excluding CDL 0 and 255.

x-dataset.temporal_grain: Calendar year × original CDL crop/land-cover class
x-dataset.spatial_grain: Story County annual valid CDL mask; county totals

provenance.transformation: Byte-for-byte copy of an existing validated CSV; no aggregation, imputation, conversion, or rounding.

requirements: Exact ordered source columns and declared CSV types.
Unique, non-null natural key within the declared spatial scope.
Finite numeric values, declared ranges, exact coverage and missing counts.
Source and output records identical, including order, precision and null markers.
Source/output/schema SHA-256 values and manifest metadata agree.
Dataset-specific calendar, denominator, quality and unit-consistency checks.
Per-year/per-pair denominators match documented values, area sums equal denominators, and every percentage recalculates within 0.000050001 percentage points.

warnings: Preserve source CDL_Class_* label placeholders; not all class names are resolved. CDL 0 and 255 are excluded; source 2024–2025 products are harmonized to 30 m.

x-csv.note: NULL and empty cells decode to JSON null only in nullable fields. Identifiers such as mukey stay strings. Units=null means not applicable or not separately verified.
